gnosh mcp

  Manage MCP servers.

  None of these commands is built yet in this build of gnosh: typing one stops
  with a message that says so.

Usage
  gnosh mcp <command> [flags] [arguments]

Commands
  add <name> <command>    Add a server: a name, then the command that starts
                          it, or its URL. (Not built yet.)
  add-json <name> <json>  Add a server from its description in JSON. (Not
                          built yet.)
  get <name>              Show one server. (Not built yet.)
  list                    List the servers. (Not built yet.)
  remove <name>           Remove a server. (Not built yet.)

Flags
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
